body:
Name: Rabbit

Weapon: Stone Axe, 3 Carrots

Armour: Iron Pants, Leather helm, tunic, and boots

Abilities: right click a carrot and get speed I and jump boost I for 10 seconds. Cool down is 7 seconds. The wood sword has a 17% chance in freezing the opponent (they can hit and turn though) for 2 seconds

Level: 32
